statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); ∀ x n : ℕ, n ∈ block x → ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt (n^2+1) ≠ 0 → ¬ (n^2+1).Prime → ∃ p k : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ Odd k ∧ 3≤k ∧ n^2+1=p^k ∧ p^3≤(2*x)^2+1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0065 · 将所有非素的 Mangoldt 支撑限制为小底数奇幂
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0065 · Restrict the composite Mangoldt support to odd powers with small base

brief.zh: 用素数幂支撑和非平方性，逐点控制底数。
brief.en: Use prime-power support and the absence of squares to bound each base.
